The '''Weldii system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The third [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position within the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was occupied by the terrestrial [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Weldii III]].<ref name="UB3" />

Weldii III was home to a [[Unidentified mining colony (Weldii III)|mining colony]],<ref name="UB1" /> and its population included members of the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Human/Legends|Human]], [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]], [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]], and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. At some point, the local [[Miner/Legends|miners]] staged a [[Rebellion on Weldii III|rebellion]], in which the [[Arms dealer/Legends|gunrunner]] [[Praaelon Di]] [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] weapons to both sides of the conflict.<ref name="UB3" />

{{RPG}}
Sometime between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="Date 1 BBY">According to {{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished1|text=Unfinished Business, Part 1: Gunrunner|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}}, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] utilized [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[attack on Praaelon Di]] took place. ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' establishes that the Alliance acquired the resources necessary to start the production of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]] a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which translates to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the attack on [[Praaelon Di]] must have occurred no earlier than 1 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|BBY]].</ref> and [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date 3.5 ABY">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished2|text=Unfinished Business, Part 2: Well-Armed and Dangerous|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}} features [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] as a participant in the [[attack on Praaelon Di]]. {{WEGCite|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|story=Bounty's Due}} depicts [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] being [[Death/Legends|killed]], while ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project, which includes the ''Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook'', to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. Therefore, the attack on [[Praaelon Di]] must have occurred no later than 3.5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> after [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Lenc]],<ref name="UB3" /> the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] leader of Weldii III's mining [[Colonist/Legends|colony]], learned of Di's involvement in the rebellion, the administrator hired a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] to capture the arms dealer and bring him back to Weldii III.<ref name="UB1" /> Lenc's agents were [[Attack on Praaelon Di|defeated]] by the gunrunner and his allies,<ref name="UB2">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/unfinished2|text=Unfinished Business, Part 2: Well-Armed and Dangerous|int=Unfinished Business (scenario)}}</ref> and subsequently Di and his associates traveled to Weldii III, where they ultimately [[Attack at Mine Shaft 342|defeated]] Lenc and his underlings.<ref name="UB3" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MineShaft342bunker.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Weldii III and the Weldii system serve as the setting of "Unfinished Business, Part 3: Shafted!."]]
The Weldii system de facto first appeared via the appearance of Weldii III in "Shafted!,"<ref name="UB3" /> the final installment in "[[Unfinished Business (scenario)|Unfinished Business]]," a series of three scenarios for use with the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Miniatures|''Star Wars'' Miniatures]] game. The series was written by [[Sterling Hershey]],<ref name="UB3" /><ref name="UB1" /><ref name="UB2" /> and the third scenario was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="UB3" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' first named the Weldii system and placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />

The narrative structure of the three scenarios of "Unfinished Business" is dependent on the gameplay outcome of each individual scenario.<ref name="UB3" /> If the player representing Praaelon Di and his allies in-game is victorious in the first scenario, "Gunrunner," the second installment, "Well-Armed and Dangerous," is to be skipped, and the narrative proceeds with "Shafted!."<ref name="UB1" />

In addition, if in "Well-Armed and Dangerous" the player controlling the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] wins, Di is considered to be captured and brought back to Lenc<ref name="UB2" /> on Weldii III,<ref name="UB1" /> with "Shafted!" to be skipped.<ref name="UB2" /> This article assumes that as many events as possible of "Unfinished Business" play out as described and that Di and his allies are defeated in "Gunrunner," yet triumph in "Well-Armed and Dangerous" and "Shafted!."
